chars.ZAKIA: ZAKIA: a stylish young Moroccan woman, 25, long wavy dark brown hair, wearing a mustard-yellow blazer over a white top, gold hoop earrings
chars.SALMA: SALMA: a young Moroccan woman, 25, black hair in a tight high bun, thick black glasses, wearing a bright red long-sleeve dress
chars.GIRLS: GIRLS: two young Moroccan women coworkers, one in a pastel pink hijab and denim jacket, one with short curly hair and a green sweater

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Evening in a cozy restaurant in Casablanca, friends around a table with tajine and mint tea. SALMA suddenly stands up with a fake wide smile, pointing at ZAKIA who sits frozen and embarrassed with wide eyes; GIRLS look surprised. Comic awkward tension.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: SALMA leaning over the restaurant table, talking loudly to GIRLS with an exaggerated sweet smile and raised eyebrows, hand on her chest, GIRLS listening curious.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: SALMA throwing her head back laughing mockingly at the table while ZAKIA next to her holds a tea glass with a stiff awkward smile, cheeks red.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot: ZAKIA forcing a polite smile, replying to SALMA across the table, her eyes betraying hurt; SALMA smirking in the foreground blurred.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: SALMA laughing and gesturing theatrically with both hands to GIRLS, as if giving a dramatic speech at the restaurant table, GIRLS exchanging uneasy glances.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: SALMA pointing at ZAKIA with a condescending smile and counting on her fingers, mocking her, while ZAKIA stares down at her plate; GIRLS awkward in the background.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: GIRLS frozen at the restaurant table, mouths slightly open, shocked silence, one holding a fork mid-air, tea glasses on the table, warm restaurant lights.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: ZAKIA slamming her palm on the table and turning sharply toward SALMA with an angry fiery glare, ready to explode; SALMA's smile fading in surprise.
